name: ICARUS at the Fermilab Short-Baseline Neutrino program — Initial Operation

summary.plain: The paper describing how the refurbished ICARUS T600 detector was installed and started taking data at Fermilab.
summary.technical: Eur. Phys. J. C 83 (2023) 1 (arXiv:2301.08634): the shipping, installation, cryogenic commissioning and initial physics operation of ICARUS-T600 as the SBN far detector at Fermilab, 2017-2021.
